exposure: Infants born small for gestational age (SGA)
outcome: Cervical dilation at time of cesarean delivery
Incidence of cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal status
cohort: 260 women who underwent induction of labor and delivered infants born SGA (<10th percentile birth weight) at a single institution between 2008 and 2012
finding: In pregnancies complicated by SGA, cervical ripening with misoprostol was not associated with an increased rate of cesarean delivery compared with dinoprostone or Pitocin/Foley balloon.
